subject: Notice: EdgeCloud APAC connector decommission — action required
messages:
From: EdgeCloud Ops <ops@edgecloud.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bigfinbank.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: APAC connector decommission schedule and migration options

Hi Aisha / Karthik / Lauren,

We wanted to let you know about scheduled changes to our APAC edge connector footprint. Over the next 90 days we are decommissioning a set of legacy connectors (apac-eu-legacy-1/2) to consolidate on our new regional fabric. The net effect is that traffic routed through older connectors will need to move to the new apac-fabric endpoints.

Key dates (high level):
- 2027-04-15: start of phased reroute testing window
- 2027-05-20: mandatory cutover for connectors in Singapore region
- 2027-06-30: final decommission of apac-eu-legacy cluster

Attachments: edgecloud_apac_decomm_schedule.pdf, edgecloud_migration_checklist.xlsx

Compliance note: we have included a matrix mapping connectors to subprocessor locations and SOC2 control applicability. A copy of the matrix is included (SOC2_PCI_matrix_v2.pdf).

We know BigFin Bank (procurement on cc) has a few tenants using the legacy path; we recommend running the migration checklist and confirming any dependent tooling (firewalls, IP allowlists) by 2027-04-01 to avoid disruption.

Please let us know if you need a signed change notice or an extended timeline for specific tenants.

Best,
Marcus Alvarez
EdgeCloud Ops — Cloud Integrations
EdgeCloud Systems

---
[attachment: edgecloud_apac_decomm_schedule.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: edgecloud_migration_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[attachment: SOC2_PCI_matrix_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: EdgeCloud Ops <ops@edgecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@bigfinbank.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: APAC connector decommission schedule and migration options

Thanks Marcus —

Quick acknowledgement from Redwood. We appreciate the heads up and the artifacts. A few immediate asks so we can coordinate with BigFin and our infra/CS teams:

1) Can you confirm whether any IPs or ASN ranges will change for the new apac-fabric endpoints? We need an allowlist window.
2) For the SOC2 matrix: does the mapping include who is the data controller/subprocessor per tenant, or is it a host-level mapping? We will surface that to BigFin's security team.
3) Do you offer a rollback window post-cutover (48–72 hours) in case we observe production errors?

I'll loop in BigFin contacts and propose a migration pilot for one tenant during the testing window. If you can provide a signed change notice (DocuSign) and the IP allowlist by 2027-03-08, that would let us run internal approvals.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0189

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick response — answers inline below.

1) IP/ASN changes: the apac-fabric uses a consolidated Egress pool. No ASNs will change for customer-facing endpoints, but a range of IPv4 blocks will be different. We are attaching the allowlist CSV and a short patch note. Please treat the provided IP list as authoritative for firewall updates.

2) SOC2 matrix scope: the attached matrix is host-level mapping that shows which connectors touch which controls. For tenant-level data flow we can produce a per-tenant extract; that would require a short data export request (we can provide CSV per tenant).

3) Rollback: we offer a 72-hour rollback window for connectors moved during the testing window; after mandatory cutover rollback requires an incident ticket and may take longer.

Attachments included: edgecloud_apac_decomm_schedule.pdf, edgecloud_migration_checklist.xlsx, SOC2_PCI_matrix_v2.pdf, apac_allowlist.csv

We will prepare a DocuSign change notice and can send by EOD 2027-03-03.

Regards,
Marcus Alvarez
EdgeCloud Ops

Appreciate the detail Marcus —

Two quick next steps from Redwood / BigFin coordination perspective:

- Aisha: please schedule a 30-minute migration readiness call with BigFin security and our infra lead. I can own the follow-up for legal/contracting if they request an extension to the cutover date.
- Marcus: send the DocuSign change notice and the allowlist CSV to procurement@bigfinbank.com and cc our legal alias (legal@redwood.com). We will review the per-tenant extract request and confirm if BigFin needs the extended timeline.

If procurement needs a formal subprocessor change notice template, we can provide Redwood's standard copy; otherwise rely on the vendor DocuSign.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
